text: Renasant Corporation's 2026 proxy statement lists four shareholders known to hold 5% or more of its common stock, all diversified institutional/index managers: The Vanguard Group Inc. (11.69%), BlackRock, Inc. (8.84%), Dimensional Fund Advisors LP (5.81%) and State Street Corporation (5.11%). No state or state-fund investor is named.
